correctness.rationale: For every n >= 5 the adjacency identity A=J+I-B^TB and rank(B)=n prove W=ker(B) is exactly the 1-eigenspace; the projector diagonal is (n-3)/(n-1). The polar substitution y=(1-h)/(n-1) is bijective with By=1 and y>=0, preserving the Euclidean normal h. At a fractional perfect matching vertex, positive columns are independent; leaf edges have weight 1, all other components are odd cycles of weight 1/2. For q odd-cycle vertices the exact norm formula is n(n-1)(n-2)/2-(n-1)^2*q/4, maximized at q=0 even n or q=3 odd n. Polar facet distances yield the claimed radii/contact classes. Pair-permutation commutant span{I,B^TB,J} proves W irreducible, and uniqueness of John/Löwner ellipsoids makes the extrema concentric balls. Exact-rational checker and independent Petersen hull reconstruction passed; finite checks were not substituted for the symbolic all-n proof. Critical lemmas have explicit proofs and boundary n=5 is handled.

value.rationale: The canonical orthonormally scaled Kneser pair-eigenpolytopes form a natural infinite, unbounded-dimensional family, with a previously opaque metric even for the classic Petersen case. The theorem computes BOTH unique extremal ellipsoids and identifies every insphere-tangent facet, exposing a structural parity transition from perfect matchings to triangle-plus-matching decompositions. It connects symmetric spectral geometry to fractional matching polarity and contact-frame optimality; this exact global classification is mathematically useful beyond computational enumeration, a renaming or a routine isolated special case.
